verification.browserScope: Real list router installed host/document listeners, controllers, queue, adapter and Wasm. Synthetic ordinary insertion, keyboard undo with beforeinput/input echoes, cut/paste, composition with transient selectionchange, exact original selection undo and saved redo in a fresh Session V6 owner. Uncancelled native edit followed by scripted DOM mutation repairs canonically; stale repair tasks and disposed late events remain inert. A valid late composition echo retains exact render identity, proving no extra repair. Prior list toolbar/controller/clipboard suites also rerun.
